public_rationale: The weakness holds for adaptation in the unfamiliar interactive environments tested by ARC-AGI-3: frontier systems scored below 1% in March 2026 on its action-efficiency measure, not percentage of tasks solved [e1]. The broad historical claim is qualified by Google's February 19, 2026 disclosure that Gemini 3.1 Pro achieved a 77.1% ARC-AGI-2 score, described by Google as verified, on new static logic patterns [e2]. Together, these results show substantial static-puzzle success alongside severe interactive-adaptation weaknesses before April 1, 2026 [e1, e2].
limitations: The ARC-AGI-2 result is reported by Google; the packet does not include a separate verification report [e2].
Success on new static puzzles does not establish that the task family was absent from training or that models reliably transfer to unfamiliar domains [e1, e2].
The benchmarks use different scoring methods and do not directly measure geopolitical forecasting or military strategy [e1, e2].

criteria.contradiction_condition: Verified evaluations show substantial success on genuinely new tasks, materially qualifying the assertion that generative AI has never been good at such transfer.
